thread:
Maya Patel: quick design nit from QA: in the retention modal the region dropdown shows "us-west-2, eu-..." and then 'Add key' CTA jumps below a long help text, feels weird when skim-reading :thinking_face:
Jon Rivera: I noticed that too — on smaller viewports the dropdown truncates region names and we lose the KMS badge context (user can't tell if key is customer-managed)
Priya Desai: agree. two separate issues: 1) truncated region labels, 2) KMS/badge copy is ambiguous. users keep asking "who owns the key?" in support
Maya Patel: proposal: show full short name + region code, e.g. "Europe (eu-west-1)" instead of "eu-..." so it's always clear even when truncated
Sam Liu: UI-wise we can switch dropdown from fixed width to grow-with-content for desktop and use tooltip on hover for mobile. cheap win
Jon Rivera: on the KMS copy: current badge says "KMS: Enabled" which is meaningless. options: "Encryption: Redwood-managed", "Encryption: Customer-managed (KMS)", or just "Customer key (KMS)"
Priya Desai: I prefer "Customer-managed key (KMS)". explicit and matches support docs. shorter alt: "Managed by you (KMS)"
Maya Patel: +1 on explicit phrasing. also accessibility: the badge is purely visual. screen readers read "button" only. we need an aria-label like: aria-label=\"Encryption: Customer-managed key (KMS)\"
aria-bot: Accessibility check: contrast ratio of badge text on token background is 3.8:1 which fails AA for small text. Recommend bumping to 4.5:1 or using semi-bold and slightly larger font
Sam Liu: noted — I'll update the token style. for color suggestions, what about using #0b69ff for text on that badge?
Jon Rivera: sounds good but test with hover/outlines. also reorder CTAs: currently primary is "Save" then "Add key" is secondary — that feels backwards when user is managing encryption. suggestion: primary CTA should reflect the action most likely: if KMS changes present, make "Add key" prominent
Priya Desai: can we do contextual primary? if user toggles to customer key flow, set primary to "Add key" else default to "Save". keeps flows consistent
Maya Patel: UX flow nit: the help text explaining retention + encryption is >3 lines and pushes the KMS control off-screen on small laptops. can we collapse into a 1-line summary with a "Learn more" link to expand?
Sam Liu: implement collapsed summary + expand link. we'll use progressive disclosure for mobile.
Jon Rivera: audit log copy also popped up in regression tests — entries read "encryption changed" without actor or key id. proposed shape:
```
[2026-02-12 11:32:02] Maya Patel changed encryption setting to Customer-managed key (KMS: arn:aws:kms:...)
```
We should include who, what, and key id for traceability
Priya Desai: +1. also timestamp format: ISO-like shown above is good. ordering in console: most recent first but in audit downloads we should output chronological (oldest first). make sure UI labels communicate which ordering is used
Maya Patel: tiny copy tweak for the retention dropdown: change label from "Retention (days)" to "Retention period (days)" — clearer for product managers
Sam Liu: I can make the front-end changes. will also add aria-labels to badges and ensure contrast update. plan to prototype two copy options for KMS badge in next round (explicit vs short)
Jon Rivera: leaving a TODO: run these copy options by legal for any wording implying key custody. Priya — can you loop in compliance?
Priya Desai: on it. I'll ping @compliance and get sign-off. expect feedback tomorrow
Maya Patel: thanks — if we can get the prototype by EOD Thursday we can ship a small UI patch next week. :tada:
aria-bot: Accessibility checklist added to thread: "badge aria-labels, contrast >=4.5:1, keyboard focus order stable, dropdown tooltip on truncated items"
Maya Patel: perfect — I'll update the design file and leave notes on the copy variants.
